job: Between patients, wipe down the high-touch ledges in the clinic: the corridor window sill and the ledge at the reception desk in the waiting room.

world.source: hand-written scenario, not a scan: an outpatient clinic corridor and waiting room: shallow high-touch ledges

output.understood_as: Between patients, wipe down the two high-touch surfaces in the clinic: the corridor window sill and the reception-desk ledge in the waiting room.
steps: Wipe the corridor window sill in pressing strokes.
Go to the waiting room and wipe the ledge at the reception desk.

tasks.why: The corridor window sill is a high-touch surface the job asks to have wiped down.
The reception-desk ledge in the waiting room is the other high-touch surface the job names.

demos.why: Shows the stroke pattern and coverage for wiping a narrow ledge or sill edge to edge.
Sets how firmly to grip the cloth so it does not slip or bunch while pressing down on the surface.

questions: How will the robot know a patient has left? There is no signal for this yet, so please say whether it should run at set times or be started by staff.

Should the cloth be used with a disinfectant? The robot can only wipe with a cloth. Spraying or dispensing cleaner is not something it knows how to do, so someone would need to pre-wet or supply treated cloths.
Where is the cloth kept, and should a fresh cloth be used for each round or each surface? No pickup spot or drop-off for used cloths has been located.
Are there any other high-touch surfaces you want included, such as door handles or chair arms? Only the corridor sill and the reception ledge have been located so far.
